predictors: Artist Appeal on its explicit availability cohort
exploratoryAnalysis: cross-era with explicit vintage and surviving-supply limitations
validationRules: Never alter the frozen V7 predictor formulas, constants, cohorts, or fingerprints after joining price.
Use grouped validation by set; never random-split cards.
Report Artist-available and Artist-unavailable cohorts separately.
Treat missing Artist Appeal as unavailable, never numeric zero.
Cross-era evidence cannot invalidate Appeal solely because vintage surviving-supply effects are unobserved.
Treatment and Pull Scarcity remain controls; a positive interaction does not automatically promote either into Appeal.
recommendedMetrics: sign consistency by set and era
